replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
We're a site that mostly consists of 10 - 20 year olds on a game that is synonymous with Lego... what professionalism is there? XD

HTML already does all of what BBCode does, it's just a bit harder to do... I'm pretty sure that if anyone was really invested in abusing the server they would've done it already...

It's just easier to do especially for formatting map submissions and other things, it's much more cleaner than HTML and much easier to do.

You can even post youtube videos by simply pasting the Youtube ID between the brackets, the question for putting in BBCodes is why not?

It's simple. It's effective. And it gets the job done.
